Indian Standard 

SPEaFICATION FOR 
VANADIUM PENTOXIDE 

( First Revision ) 


(Reaffirmed 2000 
{Reaffirmed 2011) 
(Reaffirmed 2016) 


1. Scope — Requirements of vanadium pentoxide used for the production of ferrovanadium. 

2. Grade — Vanadium pentoxide shall be of one grade only. 

3. Supply of Material 

3.1 General Requirements — According to 13:1387-1967 ‘General requirements for the supply of 
metallurgical materials (first revision ) 

3.2 The material shall be supplied in the form of properly cleaned lumps free from any slag and 
non-metallic residues. 

4. Chemical Composition — The chemical composition of the material shall be as given in 
Table 1.

published, the determination of chemical constituents sn&frb^-'as agre'ed to between the purchaser 
and the supplier. 

5. Size —Fines below 3 mm shall not exceed 1 percent. 

6. Packing and Marking — The material shall be supplied, packed in suh^ble containers, in 
quantities mutually agreed to between the purchaser and the manufacturer. 

■A 

6.1 The material shall be marked with 1he manufacturer’s name or trade-mark. 

6.2 IS! Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

7. Sampling — As agreed to between the purchaser and the manufacturer.
